Name: Mizu's Reindeer
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Do you want to celebrate the Winter Star a little early this year? Do you like the jingle jingle of the sleigh? This mod is for you if you like all things about reindeer! It adds reindeer as a new [b]barn [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Reindeer give [b]Reindeer Milk[/b] every two days. This can be pressed into [b]Leipäjuusto [/b]cheese in the [b]C[/b][b]heese Press.[/b][/*]
[*]Reindeer drop [b]Raw Velvet[/b] every five days at medium friendship. This can be spun into [b]Velvet Cloth[/b] on the [b]L[/b][b]oom.[/b][/*]
[*]Reindeer drop [b]Antlers[/b] every ten days at high friendship. [/*]
[*]Two cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller.[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the [b]Special Order: Reindeer Parade. [/b]This order is available only in Winter.[/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to drop a variety of animal products. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][b]Special Power Utilities[/b][/url] [b]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the recipe book to be dynamic between configuration options.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 3 extra recipes to find and cook up. These recipes are automatically included in the book giving the base recipes, for a total of 5.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] compatibility. If Livestock Bazaar is installed, you can instead find a Starlight Reindeer in the mountain woods after a very special festival and lead it home. This option replaces the Starlight Reindeer being a low chance purchase from Marnie.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Brown and Gray appearances are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Blonde Reindeer [/b](false by default): Enables the Blonde Reindeer texture and adds it to the possible reindeer appearances.
[b]Enable White Reindeer [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the White Reindeer texture and adds it to the possible reindeer appearances.
[b]Enable Starlight Reindeer [/b](false by default): Enables the Starlight Reindeer and adds it as an alternate animal, there is a small chance of getting one when purchasing from Marnie. These variants are always male and drop velvet every other day instead of producing milk.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
